rule: A row listed here has an expected outcome that the dataset builder verified in a way the crawler's design cannot reproduce. The expected outcome is NOT changed. The row is reported as ORACLE-LIMITATION, listed separately, and not counted as a crawler bug in Phase 1 or Phase 2. Rows are added here only by an explicit decision of the project owner.

rows.T0901: The dataset oracle was verified with http://94.140.14.14 (HTTP 302 to a named site). The importer rewrites every input to https://host (normalize_website), and https://94.140.14.14 answers differently (a robots.txt that disallows crawling), so the crawler is judged on a URL the dataset did not verify.
